scope: All 20 rules x 9 pairs; direction groups observed only inside DEVELOPMENT 2005-01-03 to 2014-12-31.

direction_definition.+1: long foreign currency / short USD under USD-per-foreign canonical prices

cohort: Each block includes only original eligible closed trades with both entry and exit inside that block. Full signed simple return comes from saved gross_simple_return_pct, including short daily-return accounting. No forced close.
diagnostic_flags: Negative sum in D1 and D2; >=10 eligible closed per subperiod is a descriptive support flag, not a newly approved screen or frozen rule.
cautions_en: D includes trades spanning the 2009/2010 boundary, so D1 plus D2 need not equal D. Cross-boundary trade counts and return differences are saved separately for every direction.
Long and short groups are not independent market samples. A directional pattern can reflect the USD environment of that historical period and requires subsequent independent IS segment evaluation.
Rejecting one direction can reduce trade retention or change win rate and payoff. This observation does not simulate a filter or establish an original SCREEN pass.
